name: SIMPL# sample
description: A small SIMPL# Pro program written the way the program template is: an XPanel at IP ID 03 and an EISC at IP ID 10. It toggles a light, echoes a slider as text, upper-cases text, runs a one-second heartbeat timer, adds a console command (sample) and passes a button to the EISC. It is built with OpenVP, from samples/SampleProgram.
panel: XPanel at IP ID 03; EISC at IP ID 10
tryIt: On the test panel press digital 1 (the light toggles), move analog 1 (it comes back and shows as text on serial 1), type text on serial 1 (upper case comes back on serial 2) and watch analog 10 count. In the console type: sample.
